string.text: Proof-of-concept: engine inventory slot 15 as a dedicated pistol holster. Holster scans for a pistol (favorites first) and moves it into slot 15. Draw raises/lowers that slot. Unequip returns it to your bag. Inventory UI cell is blank for now - the equipped pistol stays highlighted in the bag.
Finds a pistol in your inventory (favorite first) and moves it into equipment slot 15.
Raises or lowers whatever is in slot 15 (same as a normal weapon slot).
Moves the item in slot 15 back into your bag.
